FVTK.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
FVTK.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log Foundry VTT Toolkit activity to the browser console.
FVTK.Import.Title: Build campaign from NotebookLM
FVTK.Import.Instructions: Paste the ##ENTRY blocks from NotebookLM, or choose the file you collected them in. The toolkit checks the campaign, generates missing scene images, imports journals, items, NPCs and playlists, builds and sets up the scenes, and picks YouTube tracks. The preview shows what each entry becomes before anything changes.
FVTK.Import.File: …or choose a file exported from NotebookLM (.md or .txt):
FVTK.Import.ImageFolder: Scene image folder. Locations and scenes whose name matches an image file, e.g. the-overlook.jpg, also become Foundry scenes; generated images are saved here (default: the world's assets/notebooklm folder):
FVTK.Import.ImageFolderError: Could not read the scene image folder {folder}; importing without scenes.
FVTK.Import.Overwrite: Replace journals, items, NPCs, scenes and playlists that already exist with the same name (picked YouTube tracks are kept)
FVTK.Import.GMOnly: Only a GM can import from NotebookLM.
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeKey.Name: YouTube Data API key (GM)
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeKey.Hint: Used by the YouTube track picker to search. Stored only in this browser, never sent to players. Create one in Google Cloud Console (YouTube Data API v3) and restrict it to this site.
FVTK.YouTube.ClosedNotice: YouTube music is off on your screen until the next track starts.
FVTK.YouTube.PlayError: YouTube could not play "{title}" (error {code}); the owner may not allow embedding. Pick another track.
FVTK.YouTube.NoKey: Add your YouTube Data API key in Configure Settings → Foundry VTT Toolkit to search. You can still paste links.
FVTK.YouTube.QuotaHint: Each YouTube search uses about 101 of your 10,000 free daily units; a row uses up to {searches}.
FVTK.YouTube.NoResults: No embeddable music videos of a minute or more found; try another search.
FVTK.YouTube.BadLink: That is not a YouTube video link.
FVTK.YouTube.NoPlaylists: Create or import a playlist first.
FVTK.Settings.GeminiKey.Name: Gemini API key (GM, optional)
FVTK.Settings.GeminiKey.Hint: With a key, the YouTube track picker asks Gemini for short searches and real tracks that match each description, then checks them on YouTube. Get one free at aistudio.google.com. Stored only in this browser.
FVTK.Settings.GeminiModel.Name: Gemini model
FVTK.Settings.GeminiModel.Hint: gemini-flash-lite-latest always points at Google’s current Flash-Lite model, which answers in about a second. If the model you set is busy, the picker tries Flash-Lite once.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiOff: Add a Gemini key in settings for smarter searches.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiError: Gemini did not answer ({message}); used plain searches instead.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiBusy: Gemini is busy ({message}); used plain searches, and skipping Gemini for the rest of this search. Try again in a few minutes.
FVTK.YouTube.GeminiSkipped: Gemini skipped (busy earlier in this search); used plain searches.
FVTK.Settings.ImageProvider.Name: Scene image generator (GM)
FVTK.Settings.ImageProvider.Hint: Locations and scenes with no matching image get one generated during a NotebookLM import, for you to review before upload. Pollinations is free with no account (slow, small watermark). Cloudflare uses your own free Worker (see docs/notebooklm/format.md).
FVTK.Settings.ImageStyle.Name: Scene image style
FVTK.Settings.ImageStyle.Hint: Put in front of every image prompt, before the entry's visual: field or description.
FVTK.Settings.ImageAutoApprove.Name: Keep generated images without review
FVTK.Settings.ImageAutoApprove.Hint: Upload every generated scene image and carry on with the import, without waiting for you to approve them.
FVTK.Settings.CloudflareUrl.Name: Cloudflare Worker URL
FVTK.Settings.CloudflareToken.Name: Cloudflare Worker token
FVTK.Settings.CloudflareToken.Hint: The TOKEN secret you set on the Worker, if any. Stored only in this browser.
FVTK.Images.Title: Scene images
FVTK.Images.Hint: Generating with {provider}. Edit a prompt and regenerate anything you don't like, untick what you'd rather leave without a scene, then upload.
FVTK.Images.WillGenerate: {count} scene images will be generated with {provider} for you to review.
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeAutoPick.Name: Pick YouTube tracks during import
FVTK.Settings.YouTubeAutoPick.Hint: After a NotebookLM import, fill every imported playlist that has no YouTube tracks yet with the top search result for each track line (about 2 searches, 200 quota units, per line). Change any pick later in the YouTube track picker.
FVTK.YouTube.AutoPicking: Picking YouTube tracks for {count} track lines…
FVTK.YouTube.AutoPickQuota: YouTube's daily search quota ran out; picked so far: {summary}. Run the YouTube track picker tomorrow for the rest.
FVTK.YouTube.AutoPickNoKey: {count} playlists have no YouTube tracks. Add a YouTube Data API key in settings to have them picked during import.
FVTK.Import.CheckIssues: Campaign check: {count} gaps (click to see them and a fix prompt for NotebookLM)
FVTK.Import.CheckMore: …and {count} more (all are in the fix prompt).
FVTK.Import.CheckFix: You can import now and fix later. To fix, paste this into NotebookLM in the same notebook, then build again with its answer: entries with replaces: update what is already there.
FVTK.Import.Copied: Fix prompt copied. Paste it into NotebookLM.
FVTK.Import.Summary.Title: Campaign built
FVTK.Import.Summary.Documents: Documents: {created} created, {updated} updated, {relinked} earlier ones re-linked.
FVTK.Import.Summary.Scenes: Scenes created or updated: {count}, each with hidden NPC tokens, a journal pin and its soundtrack.
FVTK.Import.Summary.Skipped: Skipped: {count} (the list is in the browser console, F12).
FVTK.Import.Summary.Issues: Campaign check gaps: {count}. Build again with NotebookLM's fixes to close them.
FVTK.Adventure.Title: Pack the NotebookLM campaign
FVTK.Adventure.Caption: Built from NotebookLM in {world}
FVTK.Adventure.Description: {scenes} scenes, {actors} actors, {items} items, {journal} journals, {playlists} playlists and {folders} folders.
FVTK.Adventure.Hint: Packs everything a Build campaign made, and anything you added to its NotebookLM folders, into one adventure in the world compendium NotebookLM Campaigns, replacing an adventure of the same name. Import it into another world on this server to play the campaign there. Images are not copied: they stay in this world's folder.
FVTK.Adventure.Name: Adventure name
FVTK.Adventure.Nothing: There is no NotebookLM campaign in this world to pack.
